title: Bias in, Bias out: Annotation Bias in Multilingual Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct benchmarks specifically measuring aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on general cultural, linguistic, and annotator bias.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
